subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage subsystem as the long-term accounting architecture, or prioritize the narrower repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and defer authoritative lineage promotion?
rationale: Both approaches address the same user-visible overcount but have very different scope, operational risk, and proof maturity; code review cannot choose the permanent accounting contract or stack order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land narrow repair first
options.body: Review the proven fork-identity/cache fix first, keep lineage shadow-only, and require a rebased justification plus real-corpus evidence for any remaining architecture.

options.title: Sponsor the lineage stack
options.body: Confirm the four-PR architecture, merge its dependencies in order, and require exact-head cold/warm, promotion, rollback, containment, cancellation, and performance proof before authority can change.

options.title: Pause both approaches
options.body: Hold both implementations while maintainers define the canonical token-accounting model and acceptance corpus for the underlying issue.

recommendation.title: Land narrow repair first
recommendation.body: Review the proven fork-identity/cache fix first, keep lineage shadow-only, and require a rebased justification plus real-corpus evidence for any remaining architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently carried and merged the current fork and cache scanner behavior that this architecture would replace or extend.
